recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not revert ServiceRequest or re-add ImmunizationRecommendation under FHIR-27015; any cleanup of stale generated diagrams or broader post-removal ImmunizationRecommendation references should be handled under the later removal work.
issue_request: FHIR-27015 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Immunization change request for R5. It requested Immunization.basedOn as a 0..* Reference element linking an immunization event to the plan, recommendation, or order it fulfilled, originally scoped to CarePlan, MedicationRequest, and ImmunizationRecommendation while excluding ServiceRequest at that time.
initial_application: Commit 9d03b8ce9189242d136e22cf5fc4f777742b4a52 added Immunization.basedOn to the Immunization spreadsheet with the approved definition, cardinality, Event.basedOn mapping, and original target list. Commit 33b409a4b6d1e678255ec1b23963da363d7f8ed8 later migrated that content into source/immunization/structuredefinition-Immunization.xml.
additional_context: The current build lists immunization as an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and the current StructureDefinition still defines Immunization.basedOn 0..*. FHIR-36061 later published a same-element change adding ServiceRequest, and commit 49ef07f437aabd36aa48b6ac67530f14bcdaa885 implemented it. Commit e073fb45ec6f5a738a9f674baf63406bfe90fb78 later removed ImmunizationRecommendation from this element while removing ImmunizationRecommendation and ImmunizationEvaluation from current core source. A checked-in SVG still mentions ImmunizationRecommendation, but it is a generated-looking diagram artifact and was not an authoritative source hunk for this audit.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current authoritative source preserves the FHIR-27015 element and purpose, while later same-element and build-scope changes explain the target list difference from the 2020 resolution.

related_jiras.note: Published same-element decision and commit added ServiceRequest as an allowed Immunization.basedOn target after FHIR-27015.
Later no-change decision about adding basedOn to ImmunizationRecommendation itself; it does not change the Immunization.basedOn audit.
